question: Click where you would place the label on the curb ramp the ring refers to.
rules: The ring is the miner's point. Click the ramp it refers to, not the nearest ramp in the crop if that is a different one.
R hides the ring, so it does not cover the ramp; the click stays.
Clicking again moves the point. Clear removes it.
Use the same placement convention on every card.

statuses.definition: A click on the ramp the ring refers to, where you would put a curb-ramp label (e.g. the centre of the tactile warning strip, or of the ramp if it has none).
statuses.label: Placed

statuses.definition: The ring sits between two or more ramps and you cannot say which one it means.
statuses.label: Two ramps, can't pick

statuses.definition: You answered Yes before, but in this view you cannot put a point on the ramp (occluded, washed out, too far). Excluded from offsets.
statuses.label: Can't place
